Join us for the live broadcast of the 5th round of the Regions Path of the Russian Cup, where Fakel Voronezh will host Ural Yekaterinburg. The match between two representatives of the First League promises to be tense and highly contested.

Date and Kick-off Time: October 16, 2025, 14:30 UTC (17:30 MSK).

Match Preview and Team Form

Fakel Voronezh is in excellent form, leading the First League standings. The team has been playing confidently, especially at their home stadium, where they have secured four victories in their last five matches. In the previous cup round, Fakel defeated Tekstilshchik in a penalty shootout. The Voronezh team is unbeaten in their last five games, showcasing a well-organized defense.

Ural is going through a rough patch in the league, showing inconsistent results. The team has suffered several defeats in recent matches, including a heavy loss to KAMAZ, which indicates defensive problems. In the Russian Cup, the 'Bumblebees' advanced past PSK Dinskaya with a 2-1 victory. The team from Yekaterinburg's strength lies in their fast counter-attacks, but their defense is often prone to errors.

Head-to-Head History

The history of confrontations between these teams highlights the competitive nature of their matches. A significant number of their games have ended in a draw. Recent head-to-head encounters have often resulted in a stalemate, underscoring the parity between the rivals.

Fakel vs Ural Prediction

Experts give a slight edge to Fakel, considering their current form and home-field advantage. The Voronezh side appears to be the more balanced team at this stage of the season. However, Ural, with its experienced players, is capable of putting up a fight and exploiting any attacking weaknesses of their opponent.
